scripts.infra:up: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/compose/compose.yaml up -d postgres redis nats step-ca opa
scripts.infra:migrate: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/compose/compose.yaml --profile tools run --rm migrate
scripts.pki:init: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/compose/compose.yaml --profile tools run --rm step-ca-init
scripts.policy:test: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/compose/compose.yaml --profile tools run --rm opa-test
scripts.certificate-renewal:verify: npm run test:certificate-issuance && npm run test:certificate-inventory && node scripts/verify-certificate-issuance.mjs && node scripts/verify-certificate-renewal.mjs
scripts.certificate-status:verify: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:certificate-status
scripts.certificate-revocation:verify: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:certificate-revocation && node scripts/verify-certificate-revocation.mjs
scripts.certificate-events:verify: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:certificate-events && node scripts/verify-certificate-event-outbox.mjs && node scripts/verify-signed-certificate-events.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:messaging && npm run test:tenant-context && npm run test:certificate-inventory && npm run test:certificate-issuance && npm run test:certificate-status && npm run test:certificate-revocation && npm run test:certificate-events
